title: Nutrition_microbiome_reproducibility: reproduction of the figures of "Sugar-rich foods exacerbate antibiotic-induced microbiome disruption"
description:
This repository facilitates reproduction of the figures from the manuscript "Sugar-rich foods exacerbate antibiotic-induced microbiome disruption", built from a small set of de-identified released tables. Every panel is rebuilt by a numbered R script that reads only from released_data/ and writes one PDF per panel.

Scripts are organised by analysis family rather than by printed figure: expensive Bayesian models are fit once and cached, then consumed by the panels that need them. The inputs needed for figure generation are available, including de-identified patient-level clinical-outcome and medication tables.

The accompanying manuscript has been accepted for publication in Nature. Once it is published, please cite the article in preference to this software.
